# Email parser fixtures

`msgreader-test1.msg.base64` and `msgreader-test2.msg.base64` are base64 encodings
of `test/test1.msg` and `test/test2.msg` from
[`HiraokaHyperTools/msgreader`](https://github.com/HiraokaHyperTools/msgreader),
used under that repository's Apache-2.0 license. They are intentionally stored
as text so the fixtures remain reviewable by repository tooling. `test2.msg`
contains an attachment and verifies attachment relationship extraction.
